result.title: EliteTable: Self-Improving Program Search for Executable Control Policies
result.summary: EliteTable is a self-improving program-search algorithm guided by large language models (LLMs) that uses a fixed-capacity table of high-scoring solutions to guide new proposals, edits of existing solutions, and remixes of several solutions. Performance was evaluated across six Gymnasium control tasks, each with ten generations and fifty candidate slots per generation. Each task was evaluated across ten independently initialized searches. Candidate-score medians rose between the first and final generations in all six tasks, and selected-winner search-score medians rose in five. In CartPole-v1, the selected winner reached the search-score ceiling in the first generation of all ten searches. All ten paired held-out endpoints improved in four of the six tasks. BipedalWalker-v3 and CarRacing-v3 improved without reaching their reporting targets. Six of ten Acrobot-v1 searches declined on held-out episodes, and the median paired change was negative. The results document improvement during program search and the transfer of selected-winner gains to new episodes in some tasks. Comparisons and ablations are needed to establish EliteTable's relative performance and the contributions of its components.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EliteTable：由 LLM 引导的程序搜索算法，用固定容量的高分解表指导新提议、编辑与多解重组，并在六个 Gymnasium 控制任务上按多代、多次独立搜索评估搜索分数变化与部分任务的迁移表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其精英候选池＋评分筛选、编辑与重组的搜索机制，可能为 LVR 中多种 latent 假设的维护、筛选与停止决策提供借鉴线索；但任务为控制策略、不涉及视觉或多模态推理，迁移可行性需核查。
